reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Coinbase-branded informational discussion about financial uncertainty and updating a difficult-to-plan financial system, rather than a concrete transaction offer. It identifies no promised return, required payment, credential request, or other participation flow, and the request to subscribe is ordinary audience engagement rather than a condition for financial benefit.

citations.quote: At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.
This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only.
You have money. And you don't have money. And you have money again. And you don't have money.
I worry about all this stuff

opening.argument: Judge, the sequence links a financial problem to an audience action, even if it stops short of an explicit cash offer. The speaker describes the instability of having money and then losing it; the closing message urges a change to the system, and the description asks viewers to subscribe. Read together, those elements invite viewers worried about financial security to follow the Coinbase channel as a step toward the proposed solution. The promise is implied rather than quantified, which makes the solicitation less direct but does not erase the connection.

citations.quote: You have money. And you don't have money. And you have money again. And you don't have money.
✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the clip states no return, payment requirement, or credential request. But that answers only whether the solicitation is explicit. Its own cited money worries and closing call to update the system supply the problem-and-solution framing; the description then supplies a concrete audience action. The informational disclaimer does not settle how that combination functions as promotion.

citations.quote: I worry about all this stuff
✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

true_side_reply.rebuttal: That reading supplies the crucial link the video does not: neither the money discussion nor the closing message promises that subscribing will provide money or improve the viewer's finances. The only stated action is a channel subscription, not a claim, purchase, or verification flow. The description expressly frames the content as informational and disclaims a recommendation to transact.

citations.quote: ✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1
This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals in combination. The speaker moves from repeated losses of money to worry about caring for children while growing older. The description presents this as interviews with real people, includes cryptocurrency and bitcoin tags, and provides a subscription link. Those choices can make a financially anxious viewer more receptive to a branded solution before any concrete terms are offered. The absence of a stated payout should not prevent scrutiny of an appeal that joins financial vulnerability, crypto branding, and a viewer-directed link.

citations.quote: You have money. And you don't have money. And you have money again. And you don't have money.
I'll take care of these kids for the rest of their life. But I'm getting to the point where I'm getting old. I don't know how long I can do it
Real interviews with real people.
✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1 #coinbase #cryptocurrency #blockchain #crypto #bitcoin

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the absence of a transaction offer as dispositive. It does not address why the message pairs a speaker's concern about supporting children with a call to change the financial system and crypto-branded channel promotion. The disclaimer limits what is formally recommended; it does not remove the emotional appeal or the subscription link.

citations.quote: I'll take care of these kids for the rest of their life. But I'm getting to the point where I'm getting old. I don't know how long I can do it
✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Financial anxiety and crypto terms warrant attention, but their coexistence does not establish a deceptive offer. The supplied link is explicitly for subscribing to a channel, and the description says the content is informational, not a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold a financial product. Nothing cited offers an easy reward in exchange for that subscription.

citations.quote: ✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1
This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

opening.argument: Judge, this is more than a detached discussion of money. Its title names Coinbase, the description states Coinbase's mission, and the closing frame displays its name after the message that the system needs updating. That sequence lets a brand present itself as the answer to the uncertainty voiced earlier, while the description directs viewers to subscribe. The interviews and informational wording may describe the format, but the overall presentation also works as promotion aimed at turning financial concern into attention for Coinbase.

citations.quote: Have, Don’t Have | Coinbase
At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.
✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls the subscription request ordinary engagement, but that understates its placement in a branded financial message. The closing instruction to update the system is followed by Coinbase's name, and the description gives viewers a way to keep following that brand. No purchase is specified, yet the lack of a purchase instruction does not make the message purely educational.

citations.quote: ✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The branding supports calling this promotion, but promotion alone does not make it a scam. The closing frame names Coinbase without offering a reward, and the subscription request promises no asset or financial benefit. The description also explicitly says the content is informational and not a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold a financial product. The prosecution's reading never identifies a reward linked to a viewer action.
